From the owner
Kitchen Remodeling From Start to Finish A kitchen remodel can involve much more than replacing cabinets. Stevens Kitchens can handle full kitchen remodeling as well as cabinet installation, countertops, demolition, drywall and framing, electrical, plumbing, flooring, tile, backsplashes, fixtures, and hardware. Working with a full service remodeling company means your kitchen project can be planned as a complete space instead of trying to coordinate every individual trade yourself. If you are thinking about changing your kitchen layout, updating the finishes, or creating a completely new space, start with a plan that considers how you actually use your kitchen.
